problem_summary.summary: Find the value that occurs more than half the time in an integer array; the input guarantees that such a value exists.
problem_summary.input_output: Input: nums of length n. Return its guaranteed majority value.
constraints: A majority element is guaranteed to exist

brute_force.explanation: Count each value with a hash map and return as soon as its frequency exceeds half the array length.
brute_force.correctness_idea: The map records the exact number of occurrences seen for every value, so the guaranteed majority crosses the threshold during the scan.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(n) expected — each value causes one expected constant-time map operation.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(n) — the map may contain every distinct input value.

optimized.explanation: Use Boyer-Moore voting: a new candidate starts with count one; matching values add support and different values cancel one vote. A majority survives all pairwise cancellations.
optimized.correctness_idea: Each cancellation removes one majority occurrence at most alongside one non-majority occurrence. Since the majority has more copies than all other values combined, it remains the final candidate.
optimized.time_complexity: O(n) — each value is processed once.
optimized.space_complexity: O(1) auxiliary — candidate and count are the only additional state.

steps.condition: count was 0, so establish a candidate.
steps.action: Set candidate to 4 and add its vote.
Increase count to 3 and return candidate 4.

edge_cases.handling: That value becomes the candidate and is returned.
It still outnumbers all other values combined and survives cancellation.
Candidate comparisons are independent of the numeric sign.
